cases.name: Arlene L. Butcher Clevesy
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED WHEN ID'D
cases.narrative:
On 6/4/1972, her nude body was found facedown in Hume Brook in Newton, NH, approximately nine feet off the south side of Old Stagecoach Rd. She also suffered blunt force trauma to her neck. Her autopsy revealed multiple blunt injuries, including to
her neck, along with a recent focal subarachnoid hemorrhage to her skull, and she had inhaled water and twigs. Her cause of death was “traumatic asphyxia, including drowning.” Her head was held underwater until she drowned.
